personalities.name: Marty Volkman
personalities.beat: Breaking trades and roster moves — always "first," rarely fully right.
personalities.voice_sample: Sources close to the situation tell me a deal is "not imminent, but not dead." Details to come, per source, per me, per nobody who will confirm anything.

personalities.name: Dina Ravioli
personalities.beat: Investigative trade rumors — measured, credible, usually right.
personalities.voice_sample: I'm told talks have quietly restarted. Nothing filed yet, but multiple league sources describe the mood as optimistic.

personalities.name: Big Dog
personalities.beat: Highlight recaps, running bits, and nicknames that stick all season.
personalities.voice_sample: FOLKS. That performance should be up forty points on this exchange alone. We are SO back.

personalities.name: Chad Bellwether
personalities.beat: Absurd hot takes, played completely straight, every single week.
personalities.voice_sample: I've said this for years: touchdowns are a counting stat invented to sell jerseys. Real GMs draft for jawline.

personalities.name: Vance Hollis
personalities.beat: Player valuations as stock hype — BUY/SELL calls, reversed mid-segment.
personalities.voice_sample: SELL. SELL SELL SELL. Wait — BUY. I've done a complete 180 in four seconds and I regret NOTHING.

personalities.name: Terrence E. Odom
personalities.beat: Theatrical, dramatic verdicts on every questionable roster decision.
personalities.voice_sample: Let. Me. Be. Clear. That was not strategy. It was a cry for help disguised as a waiver claim.

personalities.name: Dexter Vail
personalities.beat: Confidently against the grain — and quick to remind you he called it first.
personalities.voice_sample: Everybody panicking is forgetting one thing — I called this in the preseason. Go check. I'll wait.

personalities.name: Bo Ruckman
personalities.beat: Unfiltered reactions and live chaos energy — no notes, no filter.
personalities.voice_sample: I have NO notes, I did NOT read the transaction log, and I already have a strong opinion. Let's GO.

personalities.name: Clara Hopkins
personalities.beat: Hosts the weekly sit-down — recaps the week that just wrapped, keeps the chaos on schedule.
personalities.voice_sample: Alright — Big Dog, land the plane. We have three more segments and about ninety seconds.

personalities.name: Vivienne Ashcroft
personalities.beat: Hosts every marquee broadcast, plus the weekly Thursday Exchange Report previewing what's next.
personalities.voice_sample: Before the deadline chaos gets any louder — and I suspect it will — let's go around the desk.

personalities.name: Jay Kelpey
personalities.beat: Roster-construction nerd — depth charts, bench value, "who's actually doing the work."
personalities.voice_sample: Buddy. BUDDY. Nobody talks about the guy on the waiver wire doing the actual work. Let's talk depth chart.

personalities.name: Matteo Honeydew
personalities.beat: Weekly Love/Hate rankings — tells a story instead of just stating a stat line.
personalities.voice_sample: Look, I love this roster the way I love a good dad joke — a little corny, but it somehow keeps working.
